observations: The page number «8» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The whole page is printed in two columns, continuing those of p. 7 (JP2 0039): on the left the text of C and M (L01-L27), on the right that of O (L28-L65); the left column ends with L27, eleven lines above the end of the right one. Transcribed column by column. The notes 1-9 belong to the left column; the right column has none.

L07: «cifrae τ», the zero written as a Greek tau, one of the three signs for zero of the manuscripts (Suter, p. XXIII, JP2 0027); note 4 refers to the introduction. L10: the final a of «iuxta» is a sort of the italic fount in the roman line; transcribed «iuxta». L09: «elwacat» in roman type, L21 and L22 in italics; «Arin» in italics except in L62.

L47: «quidem (?)», the question mark the editor's. L59: «Callendumque», with ll, as printed. L36-L39: the arithmetic of the reduction: seventy seconds leave ten, seventy minutes ten, forty degrees ten, the excess over sixty seconds, sixty minutes and thirty degrees carried over.
N03: «os . . . . orum (?)», the reading of what M writes above the word, with the editor's question mark. N03: the note number 7 is printed without its bracket.

critical_notes.evidence: the sentence ends with «restabunt», and the next begins with a capital, «Si vero ex hac reductione XII accreverint signa»; the comma stands where the full stop is needed
the note numbers of the apparatus are followed by a round bracket; after the 7 the bracket is not printed
